#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

int main() {
    std::ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, B;
    std::cin >> n >> B;
    std::vector<int> arr(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> arr[i];
    }

    std::vector<int> evenPrefix(n), oddPrefix(n);
    int even = 0, odd = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if ((arr[i] & 1) == 0) {
            ++even;
        } else {
            ++odd;
        }
        evenPrefix[i] = even;
        oddPrefix[i] = odd;
    }

    std::vector<int> costs;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        if (evenPrefix[i] == oddPrefix[i]) {
            costs.push_back(std::abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]));
        }
    }

    std::sort(costs.begin(), costs.end());

    int budget = B;
    long long ans = 0;
    if (budget >= 0) {
        for (int c : costs) {
            budget -= c;
            if (budget < 0) {
                break;
            }
            ++ans;
        }
    }
    std::cout << ans << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
